title: 12 Best Food Halls in Casablanca
description: Discover Casablanca's top food halls, from traditional markets bursting with flavors to modern gourmet spaces. Find the best places for Moroccan delicacies, international cuisine, and vibrant dining experiences in 2026.

places.name: Marché Central
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Grilled seafood platter (calamari, shrimp, various fish) or a classic harira soup.

places.name: Les Halles de L'Olivier
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A curated cheese and charcuterie board, paired with a glass of Moroccan wine, or a gourmet burger.

places.name: Anfaplace Mall Food Court
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A pizza from one of the Italian chains or a fresh juice and pastry from a local cafe.

places.name: Morocco Mall Food Court & Dining Areas
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Sushi from a Japanese eatery or a burger from an American chain. Don't miss the views of the aquarium from some restaurants.

places.name: Quartier Habous (New Medina) Food Alley
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Bissara (fava bean soup), a selection of Moroccan pastries with mint tea, or a simple kefta sandwich.

places.name: Marché des Fleurs et Poisson (Fish & Flower Market)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Pick a whole grilled dorade or a plate of fried calamari, served with chermoula and fresh bread.

places.name: Marina Casablanca Dining Promenade
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Fresh seafood pasta from an Italian restaurant or a mezze platter from a Middle Eastern cafe, enjoying the sea breeze.

places.name: Maârif Food Hub (Twin Center Area)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A traditional Moroccan breakfast with msemen and fresh juice, or a gourmet pastry from one of the many renowned patisseries.

places.name: Bourgogne 'Rue des Restaurants'
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A 'macloutha' sandwich (grilled chicken or meat with cheese and sauce), or a freshly prepared 'khobz' (bread) sandwich with various fillings.

places.name: Food Court, Centre Commercial Tachfine
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic Moroccan sandwich or a platter from one of the grilled chicken spots.

places.name: Marché Solidaire Dar Bouazza
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Freshly baked bread with olive oil, artisanal cheeses, or a seasonal tagine cooked on-site.

places.name: La Corniche Beachside Eateries (Ain Diab)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Grilled skewers (brochettes) or fresh fish from a beachside vendor, paired with a refreshing mint tea or fresh juice.
